.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r9/task/solution/app/public/index.html, public/js/{app,board,threads}.js (grepped for probe literals and placeholders)
evidence: Enumerated every value a criterion/protocol tells the judge to CREATE and checked it against the seed (environment/assets/seed_data.json == solution/app/src/seed_data.json) and reference markup/initial state. (1) Jobs J1/J2/J3, gate jobs and all cards A-F, V-Z, A2: functional prompt.md:11,15 require 'a unique title (add a short suffix for this review)' and 'suffix every title and name for this review'; gates/constraints judge.toml:23 and polish/visual prompt.md:11 require unique title/name/email. Seed has only jobs 'Platform Engineer', 'Data Analyst', 'Product Designer' and 16 seeded applicant names; no 'J1/J2/J3' literal exists in seed or reference (grep empty). Activity/notes/messages probes are judge-authored text ('new text', 'distinctive reply', 'distinctive unsent reply': functional prompt.md:17,39; polish judge.toml:50,59). (2) The only fixed creation literal is polish hro_pol_live_board's example note 'Call back on Fri' (polish judge.toml:23, 'such as'): grep of environment/ and solution/ finds no 'call back' or 'on Fri'; the only reference placeholders are 'Reason for rejecting' (board.js:21,216). (3) tomas.varga@candidates.example IS in seed (USR-CAN2; APP-201 on JOB-DATA), but deliberately: it is the account-link probe for hro_candidate_linked, added to the judge's NEW J2 (distinct job, unique title), so the seeded Data Analyst application cannot satisfy 'the card added with Tomas's account email becomes Tomas's application' when the judge reads it by J2's title; prompt T (functional prompt.md:39) also handles a pre-existing J2 address by opening J3. (4) Reference initial state adds nothing beyond seed: db.js seedIfEmpty (57-84) inserts users, jobs, applications, messages, reads, notes only; the activity table starts empty, so no pre-existing Activity line for J1/J2 can satisfy hro_activity, and no seeded drafts exist (seed keys: generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users, jobs, applications, messages, notes, reads). (5) Seed-literal values in criteria are READS, not mutation probes, and are intentionally present: Platform Engineer order Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi / Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz (APP-105/106/108, 103/104 positions match), Noor's note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (notes[0]), Lena 1 unread (APP-301 has 3 messages, USR-CAN3 read_count 2), Noor's 120 messages (127 total minus 7 on APP-201/301/302), account emails. Broken-app attempt: an app that ships pre-made jobs/cards/notes/activity/drafts cannot pre-satisfy because every probe value is invented per review with a suffix; a stub that reseeds or hard-codes the seeded order still fails hro_restart because the judge's own suffixed records must persist. Conforming-alternative attempt: a correct app cannot be failed by a collision because the judge is told to choose unique, suffixed values; the only seeded value reused (Tomas's email) is on a different job and the same-address rule is per job (hro_add_email_rules). Limit: private check-probe-not-in-seed.py was not executed (not present in the workspace); this is a manual application of its documented behaviour, owned by the deterministic reviewer, not a checker run. No runtime evidence is needed for this source-level row; no judge, Oracle or model score is claimed.
